title: Lecture
description: A scheduled lecture in the room. Owned and stored by the API. status is derived by the API from the clock and is read-only. ends_at is strictly after starts_at and two lectures that are not cancelled never overlap.

course_code.description: Course code such as CS301, null when not set.

ends_at.description: End, ISO 8601 UTC, strictly after starts_at.

status.description: Lifecycle status, derived by the API.

lighting_mode.description: Lighting mode the engine applies when the lecture starts.

notes.description: Free text, at most 500 characters, null when empty.

LectureStatus.title: LectureStatus
LectureStatus.description: scheduled before starts_at, in_progress between starts_at and ends_at, finished after ends_at, cancelled when cancelled by a person. Finished and cancelled lectures are read-only.

LectureLightingMode.title: LectureLightingMode
LectureLightingMode.description: Lighting mode a lecture starts in.

examples.title: Distributed Systems, week 7
examples.notes: Guest talk in the second half.
